Calculates a full loan amortization schedule

amort_bal.Rd

This function produces a complete amortization schedule from a loan contract's terms. It is used within calculate_apv() to determine prepayment amounts, but it may be used as a standalone function.

Usage

amort_bal(time, orig_bal, int_rate, payment)

Arguments

time

A complete vector of payment periods (e.g., for a 60-month loan, input c(1:60)).

orig_bal

The original loan balance.

int_rate

The effective interest rate that compounds at the same frequency of the payment periods.

payment

The payment due at each payment period (e.g., the monthly payment for a 60-month auto loan).

Value

The outstanding balance at each month over the life of the loan assuming no payment uncertainty (i.e., the full amortization schedule).

Details

For a 12% annual percentage rate (APR) on a loan with monthly payments, int_rate should be (1.12)^(1/12) - 1.
